description:
Station Augments

Goes well with Station Refitting!

CAN BE ADDED TO A SAVE (USE SA_generateAugments AND SA_genSpecialContent COMMANDS) - CANNOT BE REMOVED

About

Adds station "augments" that drastically change the behavior and/or identity of your orbital station. Intended to be used alongside Station Refitting.

Augments can be found via salvaging, destroying augmented stations, or by purchasing them from a market. Augments do

NOT

dilute the loot pool, instead adding more loot in total.Augments are also applied to NPC markets; they are either handplaced, or done through an autofit. Each faction has their own pool of augments that ensures a unique experience.

The entire augment system was designed with other mods in mind, meaning other mods can create their own augments and apply augments to their own markets

without a hard dependency

.]

Modding informationHOW TO INTERACT WITH STATION AUGMENTS AS A MODDER

How to... define a new augment

Create a new stationAttachment classCreate a new SA_station_augments.csv entry (see data>campaign>SA_stationAugmentSpec.csv for examples)

It's pretty simple!

[close]How to... add an augment to a market

Either...Call market.addStationAugment() directly...Or...If the market exists after procgen, add a key-value pair of marketId to augmentId (as defined in the allAugments entry) to modSettings under "niko_stationAugments" and "MarketsWithAugments"

Modsettings can survive invalid marketIds and augmentIds, but they will throw warnings.

[close][close]

Examples

Bubble shield: A massive shield that surrounds the station and protects it from harm. Doesnt block ships, but blocks projectiles. SAFETY OVERRIDES: Need I explain this one? Faster firerate, better flux, CR drain.KL-Pattern Shield Shunt: Shield shunt, but it gives the modules a damper field instead.Axial overclocking: Makes the station spin REALLY FAST.Economy conversion: Expensive, nerfs the stations in-combat performance, but adds +1 industry slot to the market.

And more...

[close]

Compatibility

Can

be added to an existing save, but you must run the

SA_generateAugments

and

SA_genSpecialContent

commands.

CANNOT

be removed from an existing save.

FAQ

Is this mod balanced?

To the best of my ability, the cost of each augment is balanced to their strength. However, it cannot be denied that this mod makes stations substantially stronger - though the power spike is equal for all stations.

Mining station

Using nex's mining mechanics

Attracts shrouded dweller ships

Spawns near hostile ships

Has a small chance to be hostile to the summoner

Warmind Refit: Converts the station's AI core into a warmind

Better skills, cyberwarfare

Also sells merc blueprints

New augments

Sanctified Station

10 AP

Known by LP and LC

-10% flux capacity

If luddic majority active...

-40% upkeep

-1/-2 crew/supply demand

+1 to all supply (hydroponics synergy)

+15% station CR

Spawns small defense fleets that orbit the station

1 per size above 2

3 = 1 fleet, 4 = 2...

Uses LC doctrine and ships, but the market's quality

Will only ever engage in combat if the station is engaged

Mote station is now midline

High tech stations suck to fight tbqh

New lunsasettings option to enable viewing of AP to FP ratio in an augment's desc

2.3.0

PARTIALLY SAVE COMPATIBLE = PREGENERATED AUGMENTS WILL NOT UPDATE

Fixes a rare crash with drone AAF

AI Fighter uplink now tells you exactly what AI core is installed

New augments

Backline Deployment

Deploys the station near the defender's side of the battlefield

Works really well with support outfit!

Special modifications

Diktat exclusive

+4 AP

High chance to spawn on diktat markets

Reduces combat stats, but reduces hazard and increases AP by 4

IDPAI

Just IDPAI

Support outfit now applies to missiles

A few other changes and buffs

AP is now displayed in the augment menu's header

The augment menu now sorts from applied, to unapplied

Clarified that you can use best of the best to increase AP

Reduced AP cost for many augments

Core world augments reworked to make use of new augments and augment values

Augments that increase AP are now applied before others so autofit works properly

Regenerative drone now doesnt apply to stations without drones

Increased the droprate of augments to compensate for the increased number of augments

Num of augments available in a submarket is now tied to the market's size; +1 roll per market size

You are now less likely to get augments from loot that you already know

New columns in the CSV - one for name color, one for an autofit plugin

Drone-specific augments now check for drones instead of using a whitelist

A few misc bugfixes

New augments

Extreme modifications

+10 AP

Shrouded

Mantle

On module lost...

Shoves away nearby ships and destroys nearby hostile projectiles

Hostile ships lose up to 20% of their engines for a period

If module isnt armor...

Also expulses mass, like the shrouded maelstrom

Reduces flux by 40% for all modules

Lens

Same as the normal lens, except...

Fires a lot faster

Can actually hit friendly ships and missiles

Thunderhead

Basically the same as vanilla thunderhead, except it does more damage

All learned the same way as learning the original hullmods

Threat

Fragment swarm

Safe deal as normal - but with 225 fragments instead

Fragment Coordinator & Secondary Fab

Same as the hullmods

Modular Augments

Modular augments have multiple modes that alter their behavior and cost

Unless otherwise specified, modular threat augments increase in cost, power, and fragment usage as their level increases

Kinetic Fragments

Same deal as the weapon

Seeker fragments

Ditto

Swarm launcher

Level 3 doesnt increase swarm cap, instead increases swarm combat effectiveness

Defabrication Swarms

Same deal as defabrication swarms

Construction swarms

Constructs a small garrison of threat ships

Drops from threat battles

SAVE COMPATIBLE

Fixes incorrect weighting in station augments dropping from combat - should be far more common now

2.1.4

PROBABLY SAVE COMPATIBLE?

Selecting an augment no longer resets your position in the augment menu

Augments now have codex links

Augments now show what mod they are from - if correctly tagged

Augments now display what factions have them in their codex entries

Hardened/Stabilized shields blacklisted from hightech stations

Just, way too strong

Fixed random save corruption due to lambda serialization

Fixed shield shunt not allowing armor modules to use the damper field

Fixed shield shunt AI in general, actually

Factions now learn your augments if you sell them to them

Black market = pirates

Black market now takes from pirate augment pool PLUS the owner faction pool
